Ya fohi. Donne le code, je vais dormir.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The wife complains, holding the phone, exhausted. The husband, arms crossed, answers calmly, nodding toward the phone in her hand. The wife shrugs without shame and holds the phone out toward him, her face turned three-quarters to the camera.
chute: The husband stares at her, speechless, eyebrows raised. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the calm husband's speechless face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE TÉLÉPHONE DE PAPA À DEUX HEURES :
mecanisme: arroseur arrosé : la plainte de la femme révèle qu'elle fouille le téléphone, puis relance effrontée

lieu: courtyard of a house in Adjamé at night, a bare light bulb above the door, the open window of the neighbor's house on the right

persos.desc: wife in her 40s, lilac-and-violet dress, braids in a bun, hands on her hips
persos.pose: standing on the left, hands on her hips, shouting

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, tangerine-and-navy polo shirt, short beard
persos.pose: standing in the center foreground, both palms down, begging for calm

persos.nom: the nosy neighbor at the window
persos.desc: neighbor woman in her 50s, turquoise-and-indigo boubou, hair in a small bun, elbows on the window sill
persos.pose: leaning out of the open window on the right, elbows on the sill

dialogue: Tu es menteur, paresseux, et même pas beau dêh !
Doucement, chérie ! Les voisins vont entendre dêh !
Continuez, Tonton. Quartier a déjà loué les chaises dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The wife shouts, hands on her hips. The husband pushes his palms down to calm her, glancing nervously toward the window. The neighbor, elbows on the sill, says it with a delighted smile, her face turned three-quarters to the camera.
chute: The husband and the wife freeze and slowly turn their heads toward the window. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the embarrassed husband's ashamed face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LES VOISINS EN ATTENDANT LA SUITE :
mecanisme: arroseur arrosé par un témoin : le mari qui veut cacher la dispute apprend qu'elle est déjà le spectacle du quartier
